description: The plot titled “Search Space of M-Cube” illustrates the growth in the number of possible solutions as a function of the number of missing pieces in the M-Cube puzzle, comparing two conditions: “CUBE” (yellow line with circle markers, solid line) and “Flip ignored” (blue line with circle markers, solid line). The x-axis, labeled “# Missing pieces,” ranges from 1 to 6 with integer tick marks and a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “# Possible solutions,” is logarithmic and spans from 10⁰ (1) to 10⁸, with major gridlines at powers of 10. The yellow “CUBE” line starts at approximately 10¹ (10) solutions for 1 missing piece and rises steeply to about 10⁸ solutions at 6 missing pieces, with a red circle labeled “CUBE-easy” at x=2 (≈10² solutions) and another red circle labeled “CUBE” at x=6 (≈10⁸ solutions). The blue “Flip ignored” line begins near 10¹ for 1 missing piece and increases more gradually to approximately 10⁶ solutions at 6 missing pieces, remaining consistently below the yellow line across all values. Both lines show exponential growth, but the “CUBE” condition exhibits a significantly steeper increase in solution space with each additional missing piece.
